requirements.label: AMCULT 213: Introduction to Latina/o Studies
requirements.hint: Intro to Latino Studies. Also offered as LATINOAM 213.

requirements.label: Track and Elective Requirement: 4 Courses from 1 Track
requirements.hint: Min 4 courses from 1 track: Comparative Ethnic Studies, Gender and Sexuality, Migration and Transnationalism, Community Engagement and Social Action, or Arts and Media. Max 6 courses. The program publishes no fixed course list for any track: you build the track from your six additional Latina/o Studies courses (two of the six must be 300 level or above), selecting them with the Latina/o Studies director, who confirms the track at senior release, and you may propose an alternative track. The planner counts LATINOAM courses and their cross-listed AMCULT numbers; director-approved courses from other departments also qualify. Per the LSA bulletin page for the Latina and Latino Studies major and the program's Major Worksheet,.

requirements.label: AMCULT 498: Capstone Seminar in American Culture
requirements.hint: Latina/o Capstone. Also offered as LATINOAM 498.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: minimum 30 credits
requirements.hint: Counts every course used toward the major requirements, including those from other departments (e.g. cognates and the 4th term language course). The planner counts LATINOAM courses, the cross-listed AMCULT numbers for the program's courses, and SPANISH 232; any other director-approved course applied to the major also counts, confirm with your advisor. Rule per the official audit (RQ 3528) and the LSA bulletin page for the Latina and Latino Studies major,.
